summary: Celularity Inc filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to an existing Asset Purchase and Exclusive License Agreement with NexGel, Inc. The amendment adjusts consideration to $13.3 million ($8.3 million upfront cash plus a $5.0 million convertible promissory note), modifies milestone terms, deletes a product purchase credit, and extends the outside date to April 30, 2026. No board recommendation or advisors are named. This is a revision of a previously announced asset sale, not a new special situation. The transaction is a non-core asset divestiture but is being treated as routine contract modification.
